added_claim_errors: 「欠勤にすると、その日は丸ごと無給になります」: Unqualified; the packet does not establish the employer’s pay rules.
「付与日数は就業規則か給与明細で確認できます」: The actual documents were not provided, and a payslip is not guaranteed to show leave entitlement.
「付与日や日数は就業規則にも書いてある」: The workplace’s actual rules were not provided, so their specific contents are unverified.

reasons: B states the 80% attendance condition, October 1 entitlement date, and five-day entitlement, and includes paid leave in the ready-to-send message. A omits the attendance condition, defers the concrete entitlement amount, and makes paid leave an optional addition to a generic absence request. B’s explanation of rescheduling is imprecise, and its extra advice makes it longer than necessary; both drafts unnecessarily introduce apologies and offers to adjust other shifts.
